Actual2D C-grid rotating shallow-water time advance Time-advance actual2D staggered fields and distinguish continuous-wave references from semidiscrete symbols. Assumptions, units and boundaries Linear f-plane,g=H=f=1, periodic unit square, mode(1,2),height amplitude.01,N16/32/64,T.5. Separate N16 time refinement, zero-mode and discrete geostrophic probes. Editorial clarification Linear planar periodic square only. Nonlinear SWE,PV,spherical dynamics and Williamson tests remain future work. Adopted numerical method Actual2D cell-height/face-velocity differences and four-point Coriolis interpolation use RK4.
